benchmark.conclusion: All 24 matched journeys passed. All eight destination screenshots were reviewed. Median first drawing improved 3.58%, but only three of four matched pairs improved; no universal speedup is established. The approximately 1.77-second median passage hitch remains.

raw_checkpoint_summary.scope: Four matched first-new-passage transitions per variant, using the unchanged real-input passage journey and all inherited 24-process checks. Named caller phases, reference checks, checkpoint equality, player-checkpoint projection and restore are synchronous inclusive spans. Saved-state validation retains the existing observer, not a second wrapper. Nested costs overlap and must not be added. Counts are observed, not forced to the predicted reduction. Missing measured methods are zero. Full state, history, screenshots and hashes stay outside the passage timing interval; matched polling and wrapper overhead remain. One runner, AB/BA/AB/BA, no cold OS-cache or universal device claim.

source.scope: Matched baseline/candidate instrumented exports on one Windows runner. Each action starts a new process. Retained and Load use the same r1-baseline-fresh profile after real manual Save and Autosave. Verbose engine logging is enabled equally to identify shutdown resources. OS caches are not cleared.

raw_checkpoint_summary.experiment: Preserve valid saved positions and report required edited-DTL failures at continuation boundaries; compare normal reading paths against the compact-checkpoint candidate.

raw_passage_summary.scope: Four matched first-new-passage transitions per variant after 31 real encountered source captions. Destination absent from both runtime and strict semantic caches; same day parse already available. Native caption Enter selects the existing pass route. First correct drawing uses frame_post_draw; usable requires natural complete reveal and input readiness. One additional elapsed second is observed after usability. Cache inspection, full state checks, PNG encoding and hashes are outside timed intervals. Polling and lightweight observer wrappers remain inside; costs are inclusive and overlap. Missing synchronous counter means zero calls. Same runner and identical overlay, AB/BA/AB/BA; no cold OS-cache claim or device-wide guarantee. Nested destination PNGs require visual review in addition to integrity checks.
